response.sql: WITH q AS (SELECT driverId, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM qualifying GROUP BY driverId), avg_q AS (SELECT CAST(SUM(cnt) AS REAL) / COUNT(*) AS avg_cnt FROM q) SELECT q.driverId, q.cnt AS qualifying_count, q.cnt / avg_q.avg_cnt AS ratio_to_average FROM q CROSS JOIN avg_q ORDER BY ratio_to_average DESC, q.driverId LIMIT 10;
